title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your MindVault settings and data
backup-desc: Export or import your entire MindVault database
backup-desc-detail: Downloads all conversations, prompts, code snippets, and projects as JSON
restore-desc: Import a previously exported backup file
data-local: All data is stored locally in SQLite on your machine
no-external: No data is sent to external servers or APIs
local-analysis: Analysis is performed locally using rule-based algorithms
no-original: Original Claude export files are not stored in the repository
ai-config-desc: Configure AI provider for enhanced features
ai-explanation: MindVault currently uses local rule-based analysis for summaries, keyword extraction, prompt identification, and project categorization. AI-powered features will be available in a future update. No external API calls are made.
no-imports-go: No imports yet. Go to the Import page to get started.
clear-desc: Delete all conversations, prompts, code snippets, and projects. This cannot be undone.
clear-confirm-1: Are you sure you want to delete ALL data? This cannot be undone!
clear-confirm-2: This will permanently delete all conversations, prompts, code snippets, and projects. Continue?
restore-failed: Failed to restore backup. Please check the file format.
